neighbours.label: Brightness contrast in a visual description: words like 'contrast', 'against', 'bright', 'dark', 'white' when something light is set against something dark (or the reverse) — 'light-on-dark', 'stands out against a dark background'. Hue words without a light/dark opposition, and figurative 'bright'/'dark', stay quiet.
fire: On the radar image the ridges appear bright and the valleys between them dark.
Yellow letters stand out in strong contrast against the black cover of the book.
Many programmers prefer a light-on-dark theme for long sessions at the screen.
The moth's pale wings were easy to see against the dark bark of the tree.
She scratched thin lines into the black wax to make tiny white highlights.
The print shows a dark figure outlined sharply against a bright window.
Use chalk in a contrasting shade so that the marks show clearly on the slate.
In the negative the snow comes out dark and the shadows come out bright.
quiet: On the radar image the ridges appear long and the valleys between them narrow.
Yellow letters spell out the title and the author's name on the cover of the book.
Many programmers prefer a larger font for long sessions at the screen.
The moth's wings were shaped much like the leaves of the tree.
She pressed thin lines into the soft wax to make a tiny leaf pattern.
Her bright mood faded when the dark news arrived from home.
Use chalk in the same shade of green as the paint on the fence.
In the painting the roofs are red and the fields are green.

notes: Card: ' contrast' x5, ' dark' x4, ' bright' x3, ' against' x3; output promotes ' background', ' surrounding', ' difference'. Probes: contrast sentences 0.45-0.74; 'bright idea' 0.002, red/green fence 0.01, 'Dark clouds gathered' 0.005, yellow room 0.02.
